purpose: Fill the strict handback.schema.json; this file is a field guide, not a valid completed result.
status: draft means prepared candidate; blocked/partial needs explicit openItems
inventory: Every actual final draft file: path/kind=file/bytes/sha256, including untouched baseline files
diff: Actual changed paths with complete before/after UTF-8 text or null
checks: Exact fixed commands, job digest, actual exits/timestamps and full raw stdout/stderr pins; never proof from a worker claim alone
quality: pending or explicit findings; independent evaluator remains unavailable
live: unverified with concrete reason; no live session authorized
upstream: null for local; otherwise pinned template, entire prepared body, base dev, sent false
